summary: Transient shaper for drums, buses and masters: Attack and Sustain gains (±12 dB) on the onset and the body of what comes in, found by two followers of its level (Punchy, Balanced or Smooth), with an optional lookahead so the gain is already there at the first sample. Impact mode splits into four bands (zero-latency Linkwitz–Riley crossovers) and moves each band's microdynamics (its short-term level against its long-term level) with one bipolar knob, with auto gain per band. Left/right or mid/side, Mix, Delta (hear only what it changes) and a gain-match reading. Use it on a drum bus for snap or tail control, and on a master in small moves.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Gain on the onsets (the first milliseconds of a hit), 0.1 dB steps. 0 dB with Sustain at 0 dB passes the audio bit for bit

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Gain on the body and the tail after the onset, 0.1 dB steps

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: The followers' time constants. Punchy: onsets of 0.1 ms, fast release. Balanced: the default. Smooth: slower, for bass and long hits

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: The audio is delayed this long so the gain is already up at the first sample of a hit (reported to NeoBuzz Live and compensated; 0 is no latency, and the first millisecond of a hit then gets less of the Attack gain)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Attack/Sustain: the two gains above. Impact: four bands, each with its microdynamics moved by its Impact knob (Attack and Sustain are not used)

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between the first and the second band (Impact mode)

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between the second and the third band (never below Crossover 1)

parameters.name: Crossover 3
parameters.description: Between the third and the fourth band (never below Crossover 2)

parameters.name: Impact 1
parameters.description: The first band's microdynamics: −100 % takes them out (the band follows its slow level), +100 % doubles them (in dB), 0 leaves them

parameters.name: Auto gain
parameters.description: Impact mode: each band's energy stays what it was whatever its Impact (a 300 ms average, within ±12 dB)

parameters.name: Stereo
parameters.description: What is shaped: left and right (one gain for both, from the louder), or mid and side (each its own)

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed to match)

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the shaper, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the shaper changes: the output minus the input, delayed to match (gliding over 10 ms)

readings.description: Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Output would have to take back for equal loudness
The largest gain applied (to one band, in Impact mode)
The smallest gain applied (negative: the most it took away)
How much of the time the audio was in an onset (Attack/Sustain mode)
The lookahead, reported to NeoBuzz Live
